title: zapret2-manager status.json
description: Shape of /tmp/zapret2-manager/status.json produced by usr/libexec/zapret2-manager/status.uc and served (3s cached) by the ubus `status` method. The collector populates every block; the UI renders, never recomputes. Drift and queue signals are backend-computed so the watchdog (no UI) sees the same picture a human sees.

collected_at.description: Unix seconds at collection. null = not collected.

cache_ttl.description: Seconds the rpcd `status` method serves this snapshot before re-running the collector.

runtime.description: RUNTIME level: what is actually running right now (ps + list_table + actual /proc/<pid>/cmdline).

cmdline.description: Actual argv from /proc/<pid>/cmdline, NULs → spaces. Ground truth, not config.

profile_count.description: Backend-computed count of non-empty list_table lines. null = not available.

applied.description: APPLIED level: on-disk intent upstream will honor on next start (/opt/zapret2/config + /etc/config/zapret2).

generation.description: Config generation number. null = not checked / not present.

draft.description: DRAFT level: manager's own staged state (/etc/zapret2-manager/state.json). Upstream never reads this.

queues.description: Third liveness signal: NFQUEUE queue 300. Raw values from /proc/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_queue; cycle-based signals computed by the watchdog and persisted to qlen.state.json, surfaced here for display.

registered.description: false = the queue is not registered in the kernel (nfqws2 not connected). Distinct from queue_total=0.

reason.description: Why registered is false, when applicable.

queue_total.description: Field 3. Instantaneous queue length; threshold 50 + three-consecutive rule apply.

queue_dropped.description: Field 6. Cumulative monotonic counter since queue creation. Absolute value MUST NOT be compared to a threshold; consume as delta only.

signals.description: Computed by the watchdog (60s cycle); read-only mirror for the UI.

dropped_delta.description: Per-cycle delta of queue_dropped. Never negative; null when no baseline or queue recreated.

drift.description: Backend-computed divergence between RUNTIME and APPLIED. The UI renders this block; it does NOT recompute drift from mtimes or anything else. Intermediate basis (REVIEW 2): sha256 of both applied sources captured at apply time, stored in /tmp/zapret2-manager/applied.sha256, compared each collection. Target basis: normalized runtime argv vs argv the applied state would generate. Both bases account for /opt/zapret2/config AND /etc/config/zapret2, never one alone.

divergent.description: true = running argv does not match applied state.

reason.description: Human-readable, not parsed: e.g. 'applied sha256 mismatch', 'no stored apply hash', 'process absent'.

applied_sha256.description: Hashes captured at apply time (sha256-intermediate basis).

current_sha256.description: Hashes computed this collection, for comparison.

normalized_runtime.description: Normalized runtime argv (argv-render basis). null under sha256-intermediate.

passthrough.description: Derived from draft: whether the active profile is the no-strategy passthrough profile.

service_state.description: Backend-computed service state (REVIEW 2). The UI renders this; it does not derive it. The watchdog reads the same value.

meta.description: Version, autostart, upgradable badge, autohostlist vars.

nfqws2_version.description: null = checked, no value (distinct from key absence = not checked).

autohostlist.description: AUTOHOSTLIST* vars read as-is from /opt/zapret2/config and shown verbatim; the manager applies no thresholds of its own here.

signals.description: Coarse boolean signals for quick UI badges; the queues and drift blocks carry the detail.
